prompt_en: A photorealistic fashion editorial of an unmistakably adult fictional woman in her late twenties, designed as a seductive fallen-angel maid. Give her an independently designed face with high cheekbones, deep brown eyes, and long raven waves. In a candlelit Gothic salon, she leans across a tarnished silver tea cart and sets a black porcelain cup onto its tray while meeting the camera with a confident, knowing gaze. Her black satin maid ensemble combines an opaque corseted bodice, ivory lace, a short layered skirt, sheer thigh-high stockings, decorative garter straps, and a lace headpiece, creating sensual dark-fantasy editorial styling. Large charcoal wings spread into shadow beneath a cracked crimson halo and drifting feathers. One knee bends forward as the wing tips echo the diagonal tea-cart line. Place the cart low in the foreground so its silver edge leads toward her face and the wings fill the upper frame. Cool moonlight contours her face and wings while candlelight warms skin and satin. Full-body vertical frame, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, believable hands, realistic feather and fabric detail.
negative_en: excessive HDR, low resolution, plastic-looking skin, cartoon style, unrealistic hands, distorted fingers, fake-looking background

authorial_decisions.rationale: The spatial hierarchy keeps the service action, original face, and fallen-angel silhouette legible in one glance.

authorial_decisions.decision: Contour the face and wings with cool moonlight while candlelight warms skin and satin.
authorial_decisions.rationale: The warm-cool separation supports sensual editorial depth without altering the locked wardrobe or event.
